title_zh: 香港建造业分判商合规门槛

gates.threshold_zh: 须为公司注册处开放数据可查之现存公司（API 返回命中且含 Brn）。仅用户填写 BRN 不算达标。
gates.threshold_en: Must be found as a live company on CR open data (API match with Brn). User-supplied BRN alone is not sufficient.
gates.gap_hint_zh: 未在公司注册处开放数据查得现存公司（或请求失败）
gates.gap_hint_en: Not found as a live company on CR open data (or request failed)

gates.label_zh: 机电署注册电业承办商 (REC)
gates.threshold_zh: 申请电气工种时，须在机电署注册电业承办商名册且有效。
gates.threshold_en: If electrical trade is claimed, must be on the EMSD REC register with a valid registration.
gates.gap_hint_zh: 申请电气工种但 EMSD REC 未通过／未知
gates.gap_hint_en: Electrical trade claimed but EMSD REC missing/failed/unknown

gates.label_zh: 劳工处近两年职安健定罪无命中
gates.label_en: No recent LD OSH conviction hits
gates.threshold_zh: 劳工处近约两年职安健定罪开放数据中，公司名称不得有命中。
gates.threshold_en: No matches against Labour Department OSH conviction open data (~2-year window).
gates.gap_hint_zh: 劳工处 OSH 定罪有命中或结果未知
gates.gap_hint_en: LD OSH conviction hit(s) or result unknown

gates.label_zh: 建造业议会不良／停牌公告无命中
gates.label_en: No CIC RSTCS adverse / suspension hits
gates.threshold_zh: 建造业议会 RSTCS 不良／停牌／撤销公告中不得有该公司命中。
gates.threshold_en: Must have no CIC RSTCS adverse / suspension / revocation notice hits.
gates.gap_hint_zh: CIC 停牌／撤销公告有命中

gates.label_zh: CIC RSTCS 注册分判商（如声称）
gates.threshold_zh: 声称相关工种时，须可核验为 CIC RSTCS 注册分判商（或提供有效注册号）。
gates.threshold_en: When related trades are claimed, CIC RSTCS registration must be verifiable (or a valid reg. no. supplied).
gates.gap_hint_zh: 声称相关工种但 CIC RSTCS 状态未确认／失败
gates.gap_hint_en: Claimed trade but CIC RSTCS status failed/unconfirmed

gates.label_zh: 消防处 RFSIC（如申请消防工种）
gates.threshold_zh: 申请消防工种时，须为消防处注册消防装置承办商 (RFSIC) 且类别匹配。
gates.threshold_en: If fire trade is claimed, must be an FSD RFSIC contractor with matching class(es).
gates.gap_hint_zh: 申请消防工种但 RFSIC 未通过／未知
gates.gap_hint_en: Fire trade claimed but RFSIC missing/failed/unknown
